desc:
Sorry! is the classic family board game, now on Roblox! Draw a card, ride the slides and bump your rivals back to Start. Get all 4 pawns Home first to win!

👥 2-4 players: queue up with anyone online, play with friends, or go solo vs AI
♟️ Collect 13 pawns, from the Rubber Duck and Dragon to the Mythic Chess King
✨ Skins, trails, bump effects and meme emotes to taunt your friends
🔥 Win streaks, leaderboards and daily rewards
